shortDescription: Config FortiWeb Content Routing Policy Match Details.

options.name: concatenate
options.description: Choose the relationship with the previous rule. The AND relationship has higher precedence than OR in the match sequence.

options.name: match_condition
options.description: How the values in match object interact with the match string. This field is used when 'match_object' is 'http-host', 'http-request', 'http-referer', 'source-ip', 'x509-certificate-Subject', 'x509-certificate-Extension', or 'https-sni'.
choices: match-begin (The match object ends with the match string)
match-sub (The match object contains the match string)
match-end (The match object ends with the match string)
match-domain (The match object contains the match string between dots)
equal (The match object is equal to the match string)
match-reg (The match object matches the specified regular expression)

options.name: match_object
options.description: Match against the input types in the HTTP Request Header.

options.name: parameter_name_match_condition
options.description: Parameter Name match type. Use this field when 'match_object' is 'url-parameter', 'http-cookie', or 'http-header'.
choices: match-begin (The match object ends with the match string)
match-sub (The match object contains the match string)
match-end (The match object ends with the match string)
equal (The match object is equal to the match string)
match-reg (The match object matches the specified regular expression)

options.name: parameter_value_match_condition
choices: match-begin (The match object ends with the match string)
match-sub (The match object contains the match string)
match-end (The match object ends with the match string)
equal (The match object is equal to the match string)
match-reg (The match object matches the specified regular expression)
